notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://shop.vtwonen.nl/robots.txt) has no Disallow for anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot and no blanket User-agent:*/Disallow:/, so tier (a) direct HTTP was permitted and used throughout; Playwright (tier b) was used only to verify that JS-rendered collection pages (Snize/Searchanise search widget overlay) genuinely showed 0 products where the native Shopify products.json also returned 0, to rule out a broken/empty-page false negative. TREE: union of (1) the site's mega-menu (curl of homepage HTML, parsed nav by top-level index), (2) the collections XML sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 1597 URLs, used to surface categories absent from the compact mega-menu, e.g. gordijnen/douchegordijnen/keukentextiel/tafelaccessoires/kussens/opbergers-children), and (3) each parent category page's own bubble-slider sub-nav (fetched badtextiel, beddengoed, opbergers, tuinmeubelen, tuininrichting, keukentextiel, tafelaccessoires, kussens, koken-en-tafelen, badkamer-sanitair, badkamer-accessoires, raamdecoratie pages directly) which revealed many subcategories the curated mega-menu omits. Shape/material/brand/sale attribute-filter variants of an already-included category (e.g. vloerkleden-sale, ronde/ovale/jute/beige/hoogpolige/organische vloerkleden, donzen-dekbedden, wasbare-dekbedden, vtwonen-kussens, fleece-dekens) were excluded as duplicate views of the same product pool, not distinct categories. Sitemap-only handles with zero navigational linkage anywhere (hoofdkussens, elektrische-dekens, hoodie-dekens, wikkeldekens, wasknijpermandjes, droogmolenhoezen) were checked via products.json and returned 0 products with no nav evidence of being real live categories, so they were treated as dead/legacy handles and excluded (distinct from matrasbeschermers/handdoekensets/douchegordijnen/onderbedboxen/opbergbankjes/fruitkisten which ARE linked from a live mega-menu or sub-nav and were kept with qty=0). QTY: every leaf's qty = count of unique products from paginated Shopify https://shop.vtwonen.nl/collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250&page=N (summed across all pages until a page returned <250); this is the storefront's own native per-collection product membership, not an estimate. For the three qty=0 results reachable from live navigation (douchegordijnen, matrasbeschermers, handdoekensets) the zero was cross-verified by rendering the live page with Playwright and confirming the Snize/Searchanise results widget also shows 0 product cards, so it is a genuine current 0-product category rather than a fetch failure. EXCLUDED: all Furniture (meubels: stoelen/kasten/tafels/banken and garden/bed furniture), Lighting (verlichting, binnen+buiten), Kitchen & Dining tableware (servies, glazen, pannen, karaffen, etc.), decorative-only items (manden/decorative baskets - vtwonen's own copy calls them 'decoratieve manden' and they sit under the decor nav not the storage nav; vazen, kandelaars, kunstbloemen, kunstplanten, fotolijsten, kaarsen, kapstokken, wanddecoratie incl. wandplanken, potterie, bloempotten), Wallpaper/paint/hardware (behang, verf, deurbeslag, gordijnroedes, gordijnrails, gordijnhaken, douchegordijnringen/-stangen, raamfolie, schakelmateriaal), bathroom fixtures (toiletpotten, and the pure hardware/holder items under badkamer-accessoires: handdoekhouders, zeepdispensers/zeephouders, toiletrolhouders, toiletborstels, tandenborstelhouders, tissue-houders), generic mixed accessory catch-alls with no clear storage majority (bad-accessoires, douche-accessoires), trash bins (prullenbakken group - not a storage/organization product type per rules), drying/ironing appliances and accessories (strijken, droogmolens, droogrekken, wasnetten, dweilen-vloerwissers, raamwissers), tuinzonwering/parasols (confirmed via products.json sample = garden parasols/umbrella stands, not fabric product listings), kitchen roll holders and cookbook stands (keukenrolhouders, kookboekstandaarden - holder/stand accessories, not containers), non-textile tafelaccessoires (botervloten, broodmanden, dienbladen, etageres, fruitschalen, karaffen, olie-en-azijnstellen, onderzetters, serveerplanken, servethouders, servetringen, taartplateaus, tafelkleedklemmen, warmhoudschalen, wegwerptafeltextiel-disposable/paper), pet baskets/cushions, baby/kids furniture and mattresses (bedden, matrassen, wiegjes), verhuisdekens (moving blankets - logistics accessory not home textile), and aankleedkussens (baby changing pad - baby-care equipment, not textile). AMBIGUOUS ITEMS KEPT WITH FLAGS: vloerkussens (site labels 'floor cushions' but sample SKUs are futon-style floor mattresses - LOW confidence, could be Furniture); kussenvulling (cushion filling/inserts - MEDIUM, borderline component product); opbergkasten (large wooden/metal storage cabinets - appears in BOTH the Furniture 'kasten' sub-nav and the Storage 'opbergers' sub-nav under the identical URL - MEDIUM, dual-listed); gootsteenorganisers/keukenhulphouders/keukenophangers/kledinghangers (hanger/holder-style organizer accessories rather than pure containers, but explicitly nested in the site's own Opbergers/Storage navigation - MEDIUM). No CAPTCHA or bot-block encountered at any point.
